atomic_z_baseline.audit_type: public repository metadata, README/license/docs, tree inventory and targeted source inspection
not_performed: full line-by-line inspection of every file in the 1.19 GB DankNooner repository
runtime execution of external games or binaries
dynamic tracing of proprietary game executables
third-party source or asset import into Atomic-Z

policy.default: study-only until exact licence scope, provenance, compatibility and project approval are established
policy.no_game_assets: Do not commit EA/Activision game assets, retail executables, game data tables, proprietary audio, textures, fonts or decompilation dumps.
policy.no_second_runtime: External engines/runtimes are reference material only; Godot remains Atomic-Z's sole product runtime.
policy.pinning: Use immutable commit IDs. Mutable branch links are not considered reproducible evidence.
policy.asset_provenance: Record source page, per-asset licence, acquisition date, file hash, dimensions, scale, coordinate convention and validation result.
